changes.text: The drop zone is named by its visible text through `aria-labelledby` (the `label` plus "Drop files here") instead of an `aria-label` that defaulted to "Upload files". The `hint` is now only in the description, so it is no longer read twice.

New `onreject(files)` prop, fired with the files a selection or drop discarded (wrong type for `accept`, or extras when `multiple` is false). Rejected files are also announced through a visually hidden polite live region (`role="status"`).
Focus no longer falls to `<body>` after removing a file or clearing the list: it moves to the next remove button, else the previous one, else the drop zone.
The remove and clear buttons have a minimum 24px hit area (`min-inline-size` / `min-block-size`), and the clear button gains `--ss-s-1` inline padding.
The selected-files list uses the new, tighter `--ss-gap-xs` token (md 6 / sm 4 / lg 8) for the space between files, instead of `--ss-gap-sm`.

New component: a drag-and-drop file picker with click-to-browse, `accept` filtering (also enforced on drop), `multiple`, a bindable `files` list with `onfiles`, and a selected-files display with remove and clear. Keyboard operable.
